hermes.summary: Boat does not document a Hermes recipe or template. The Hermes Agent CLI is pre-installed on every sandbox, so the route is: create a sandbox with no auto-stop, open a shell, run the Hermes setup wizard, then make the gateway a systemd service so it returns after a resume.
steps: hermes setup (or hermes model to pick a provider), then hermes gateway for the messaging gateway
Write a systemd unit with Restart=always and enable it, so the gateway comes back after a stop/resume
boat host <id> <port> if the Hermes web dashboard should be reachable

quotes.quote: | `hermes` | Hermes Agent by Nous Research. Browser tools are not pre-installed: `hermes` offers to add them. |

To run a process 24/7, do two things:

1. [Turn off auto-stop](https://docs.boat.dev/long-running-tasks/auto-stop.md#turn-off-auto-stop): `boat extend <id> --no-auto-stop`.
2. Run the process as an enabled systemd service, as shown below. It then comes back after any stop, resume or fork.
Install Hermes Agent with desktop bundles, source installers, Docker, Nix, or the Termux APT package

hermes.note: Hermes is not one of the seven harnesses boat prompt can drive (claude, codex, pi, opencode, prime, kimi, mistral), so it is a shell-level install, not a boat feature.

openclaw.summary: The OpenClaw CLI is pre-installed; boat says the gateway does not start by itself. Same shape as Hermes: no-auto-stop sandbox, ssh in, run openclaw gateway under systemd.

quotes.quote: | `openclaw` | OpenClaw CLI. The gateway does not start by itself: run `openclaw gateway`. |

dashboardOnly.answer: Partly. A non-coder can open a running sandbox's Linux desktop, watch an agent work, connect an AI subscription in the Agents & Proxying tab, and edit repositories and setup scripts in the Environment tab. Creating the sandbox and starting an agent are CLI-only in the docs; there is no template gallery or one-click agent.
dashboardOnly.quote: `boat prompt` runs Claude Code, Codex or another integrated agent inside the sandbox. **Connect an AI key or subscription first.**
